# Luis Martí

> Personal site of Luis Martí, an AI scientist: Science Director of the
> Inria Chile Research Center (the Chilean center of Inria, the French
> National Institute for Research in Digital Science and Technology),
> Chief Science Officer at Docugami, Inc., and Adjunct Professor at the
> Institute of Astrophysical Studies, Universidad Diego Portales.

His research focuses on System 2 AI and neuro-symbolic "agentic" reasoning,
causality, natural language understanding, human-AI cooperation, active
learning, conformal prediction and underspecification, multi-modal and
multi-task learning, physics-informed machine learning, nature-inspired
metaheuristics, and evolutionary multi-objective optimization. He applies
this research to document understanding, astronomy and astrophysics,
climate modeling, ocean ecology, energy, mining, and smart agriculture.
